uncertainties.description: Whether the Thursday shipment actually dispatches (depends on centre stock >= 150). (about: thursday_shipment_dispatched)
Whether the Tuesday shipment actually dispatches (depends on centre stock >= 150). (about: tuesday_shipment_dispatched)
Whether the Thursday shipment is received by hospital (depends on dispatch; arrival by 7pm Thursday, before Friday noon). (about: thursday_shipment_received)
Whether the Tuesday shipment is received by hospital (depends on dispatch and 3-hour travel; arrival by 7pm Tuesday, well before Friday noon). (about: tuesday_shipment_received)
Number of units collected on Monday (9am-5pm) = 8 hours * 12 units/hour = 96 units, but this is based on average rate; actual may vary. (about: monday_collection)
Number of units collected on Thursday from 9am to 4pm (7 hours) = 84 units at average rate; actual may vary. (about: thursday_collection_before_4pm)
Number of units collected on Tuesday from 9am to 4pm (7 hours) = 84 units at average rate; actual may vary. (about: tuesday_collection_before_4pm)
Number of units collected on Wednesday (9am-5pm) = 96 units at average rate; actual may vary. (about: wednesday_collection)

Whether the centre's stock at 4pm Thursday (after Wednesday and Thursday collections, minus Tuesday shipment) is at least 150 units to dispatch the Thursday shipment. (about: centre_has_enough_stock_thursday)
Whether the centre's stock at 4pm Tuesday (after Monday and Tuesday collections) is at least 150 units to dispatch the Tuesday shipment. (about: centre_has_enough_stock_tuesday)
Centre stock after dispatching Tuesday shipment; depends on whether shipment occurred. (about: centre_stock_after_tuesday_shipment)
